title: Scene Object Visibility Flicker
description: Scene meshes load but objects flicker in view. Stabilize chunk visibility and any per-frame visibility toggles causing oscillation.
summary: Object flicker was chunk groups toggling visible every frame at frustum edges after the loading fix kept chunks mounted. Replaced per-frame frustum culling with distance-only visibility plus enter/exit hysteresis (sceneChunkDistanceVisible), so chunks stay on until clearly out of range instead of popping at the view boundary.
